tables.title: TDES0 context descriptor
tables.text: Table 829, "TDES0 context descriptor", in section 76.10.3 (Transmit descriptor) on page 4161. Columns: Bit, Name, Description. 1 data row(s).

rows:
Transmit Packet Timestamp Low
For one-step correction, the driver can provide the lower 32 bits of timestamp in 
this descriptor word. The DMA uses this value as the low word for doing one-step 
timestamp correction. This field is valid only if the OSTC and TCMSSV bits of 
TDES3 context descriptor are set.
